info.title: doccum API
info.description: Content operations under /api/v1 -- spec §11. Generated from the live route table by App\Console\Commands\GenerateOpenApi; never hand-edited.

sanctum.description: A Laravel Sanctum personal access token. Every route also requires the token to carry the `ability:` scope(s) named on its operation, spec §11's first of three authorisation gates.

Forbidden.description: The token lacks the required ability, or the signed-in user's own permissions/directory access refuse the request.

NotFound.description: Not found, including a subject entirely outside the caller's reach.

values.description: Property key to value; validated per-key against its own PropertyDefinition.

directory_id.description: Exactly one of directory_id or file_id -- never both, never neither.

file_id.description: Exactly one of directory_id or file_id -- never both, never neither.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the uploaded object, case-insensitive hex.
